text:
erin.sec: FYI during today's RBAC sweep I found an unexpected external service account on the Vault transit wrapping key (secure-transit/wrap). appears to be partner-mirror@external-sa. This was a console grant, not in terraform. Need immediate containment + coordinated rewrap + audit.

devon.ops: can you paste the binding snapshot and any admin audit line?

erin.sec: binding snapshot:
- vault-service@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com
- svc-rewrap@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com
- partner-mirror@external-sa.iam.gserviceaccount.com  <-- unexpected

logbot: admin audit: principalEmail=admin@partner-mirror.com methodName=SetIamPolicy resource=projects/redwood-ops/locations/global/keyRings/secure-transit timestamp=2026-03-24T04:21:13Z

lee.eng: ok. immediate plan: 1) remove external principal binding now (record command and output), 2) create short-lived rewrap key wrap-ephemeral-3740001234 with strict IAM (svc-rewrap + vault only), 3) enable KMS Data Access audit logs for secure-transit keyRing and sink to security project, 4) point Vault transit wrapping to ephemeral key and run a single-object canary rewrap, 5) schedule full rewrap in maintenance window and rotate any SAs that had access, 6) disable old key after verification.

devon.ops: agreed. removing binding now but will NOT disable the old key until rewrap completes. We'll capture forensic evidence first. Removal command (running):
```bash
gcloud kms keys remove-iam-policy-binding wrap --location=global --keyring=secure-transit --member='serviceAccount:partner-mirror@external-sa.iam.gserviceaccount.com' --role='roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter'
```

devon.ops: removal completed, admin audit entry created. posting full output in incident doc.

lee.eng: creating ephemeral key now and will post resource name. ephemeral key IAM: only `serviceAccount:svc-rewrap@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com` and `serviceAccount:vault-service@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com` with `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter`. no owners/editors.

erin.sec: enable Data Access logs immediately and route to security BigQuery so we can query Encrypt/Decrypt activity. Use a dedicated sink to avoid noisy exports.

logbot: suggested sink command:
```bash
gcloud logging sinks create kms_data_sink bigquery.googleapis.com/projects/redwood-security/datasets/kms_audit --log-filter='resource.type="crypto_key" AND protoPayload.methodName:("Encrypt" "Decrypt") AND resource.labels.key_ring_name:secure-transit'
```

lee.eng: Vault change (canary):
```bash
vault write sys/wrapping/config wrap_key="projects/redwood-ops/locations/global/keyRings/secure-transit/cryptoKeys/wrap-ephemeral-3740001234"
```
Will deploy to vault-private canary pool first. Rollback: repoint to previous key if we see increased wrap failures.

devon.ops: rewrap canary plan (one object): we'll decrypt -> encrypt streaming preserving metadata. sample canary command:
```bash
OBJ=gs://partner-mirror/backups/2026-03-23/part-0001.tar.enc
# decrypt -> encrypt to ephemeral key, write .rewrap then move
gsutil cp "$OBJ" - | gcloud kms decrypt --location=global --keyring=secure-transit --key=wrap --ciphertext-file=- --plaintext-file=- | gcloud kms encrypt --location=global --keyring=secure-transit --key=wrap-ephemeral-3740001234 --plaintext-file=- --ciphertext-file=- | gsutil cp - "$OBJ".rewrap && gsutil mv "$OBJ".rewrap "$OBJ"
```

erin.sec: ensure we snapshot checksums (crc32c/md5) and store them in the incident doc before/after. Also run `gcloud logging read` queries after Data Access is enabled to list principals that used the key in the last 30 days. Example query (run once logs are available):
```bash
gcloud logging read 'resource.type="kms_key_ring" protoPayload.methodName:("Encrypt" "Decrypt") AND resource.labels.key_ring_name:secure-transit' --freshness=30d --format='value(protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail)' | sort | uniq -c
```

ops-oncall: maintenance window available 01:00-03:00 UTC. I can run the rewrap then. Ping me 20m before.

lee.eng: add monitoring: watch Vault wrap requests and KMS 403/5xx errors. If wrap error rate >3% in 5m, rollback Vault wrap config and page oncall. I'll add a temporary alert to PagerDuty.

devon.ops: we'll also rotate any long-lived service account keys that appear in the Audit results. If any external principal shows Encrypt/Decrypt activity, escalate to Legal & CISO.

erin.sec: PR to add this key to terraform will be opened and include an IAM condition to prevent console SetIamPolicy from non-admin domains. Also add a log-based alert to page sec on any future SetIamPolicy against secure-transit keyRing.

logbot: Incident INC-20260324-07 created and tasks assigned: remove binding (devon.ops) 1, create ephemeral key + canary (lee.eng), enable Data Access + sink (devon.ops), forensic timeline (erin.sec), rewrap execution (ops-oncall). Next update in 45m.

lee.eng: ephemeral key created: projects/redwood-ops/locations/global/keyRings/secure-transit/cryptoKeys/wrap-ephemeral-3740001234. opening terraform PR to manage it and the strict IAM.

devon.ops: Data Access logs enabled and sink created. posted sink creation output in incident doc.

erin.sec: starting forensic timeline now; will post any evidence of decrypted exports. keep all command output in-thread for audit.

ops-oncall: acknowledged, will be operator for the run. Ping me 20m prior to canary.

lee.eng: starting canary in 10m, will post success/failure + checksums.

devon.ops: thumbs up.
